sections.Profile:
The "Dallas" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on February 4, 1949, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: America, Single Player, Western, Wood Rail, Dancing, City

- Design: Harry Williams
